about.title: About Aaron Mechanical Air Conditioning & Heating
text: Aaron Mechanical, LLC. is a family-owned and operated residential and commercial HVAC company that serves the Humble, Kingwood, and surrounding area. It was founded by Merle Aaron Sr. in 1978, and is now owned by his son Merle Aaron Jr., who is continuing a 30-year tradition of excellence in HVAC.

Merle Aaron Jr has served on the RUUD Product Panel, Century Supply Dealer Council, Texas ACCA Board member, and has been a past President of the Houston ACCA Chapter. (Air Conditioning Contractors of America). We pride ourselves in offering the best in residential and commercial air conditioning and heating. We serve you with honesty and integrity, continuing to grow through our trained staff, competitive programs, and outstanding services.
Enjoy peace of mind knowing that we offer WARRANTIES and GUARANTEES for your equipment & services.
